name: Pogrebyonny
source:
The story is about a human(?) who has spent an endless amount of time in prison.
Not in an ordinary prison, but in the most hellish one. It is terrifying not because of some horrors, but because of its monotony.
It gives you a false vision of control; you think you manage everything in it, but that is far from the truth.
All of this is just an illusion of choice...
Will our protagonist be able to get out of it? What awaits him in the future?
And who is he, anyway, our protagonist?

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816654729]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这个故事是关于一个在监狱里度过了无尽时间的人类（？）。
不是在普通的监狱里，而是在最地狱般的监狱里。它之所以可怕，并不是因为有些恐怖，而是因为它的单调。
它会给你一种错误的控制欲；你认为你可以管理其中的一切，但这远非事实。
这一切都只是选择的幻觉……
我们的主角能否摆脱困境呢？未来等待他的是什么？
无论如何，他是谁，我们的主角？

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816654729]Steam[/url]]
